sources.snippet: Overview Huihui-Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct-abliterated is an uncensored multimodal vision-language model built by huihui-ai through abliteration of the base Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct model. The model processes images and text jointly to generate descriptions, answer questions about visual content, and engage in multimodal dialogue.
